text:
She was dead; the wound, without warmth,
was scarcely visible in her side:
a narrow escape, for so much life!

The funeral cloth was no whiter
than the corpse. No human eye
will ever see a thing whiter than that white.

Impetuous Spring was burning.
At the panes, helpless gnats
beat with rustling wings…

Warmth fled her. I said: “Are you sleeping?”
With a savage, violent smile,
I asked again, closer: “Sleeping? Asleep?”

“Asleep?” Remembering that voice
was not mine, I stiffened with fear
and listened. Not a murmur, not a sound.

Captive in the red architecture,
a strong odor of an opened grave
spread in the heat.

Death's invisible breath
was choking me in the closed room.
To the motionless woman I said,
“Are you asleep? Asleep?” Nothing, nothing…
The funeral cloth was no whiter.
On the earth of men no eye
will see anything whiter than that white!…

translation.title: A Dream
